subject: Orion Health - Mutual Success Charter & week-by-week validation plan
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>
To: Lisa Crawford <lisa.crawford@orionhealth.com>, Tom Becker <t.becker@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orion Health - Mutual Success Charter & week-by-week validation plan

Hi Lisa / Tom —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As promised, I put together a concise Mutual Success Charter (MAP) we can use to align the technical validation, procurement checkpoints, and a close timeline. The attached is a lightweight template I typically start with (Redwood_MAP_Template_v1.gdoc).

High-level ask: can you confirm the primary success criteria and the internal stakeholders who need to sign off on the pilot? I drafted a proposed 6-week validation sprint below — happy to adjust to your cadence.

Proposed week-by-week (draft)
- Week 0: Kickoff + environment provisioning (API keys, test data scope)
- Week 1: Integration & core feature smoke tests (generation + structured outputs)
- Week 2: Latency/cost profiling, KV/prefix caching validation
- Week 3: Security & data handling review (logs, retention, KMS)
- Week 4: Quality/regression checks with your prompt set + user acceptance tests
- Week 5: Closed-loop fixes + final performance signoff
- Week 6: Business review, legal/procurement checkpoint, executive signoff

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_Template_v1.gdoc (editable) — I also shared a draft GDoc link here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xOrionDraftLink

Next steps: if that cadence looks reasonable, can you confirm: 1) one or two technical owners; 2) the procurement timeline we should target for signature (e.g., by end of June); and 3) whether a security questionnaire or SOC2 evidence will be needed during Week 3?

Thanks — I’ll iterate the doc once I have your stakeholder list.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com
(415) 555-0189

From: Lisa Crawford <lisa.crawford@orionhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Tom Becker <t.becker@orionhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Orion Health - Mutual Success Charter & week-by-week validation plan

Hi Naomi —

Appreciate the clear plan. Overall this makes sense and we like the week-by-week framing. A couple of notes from our side:

- Stakeholders: please add the following to the MAP as approvers/participants: Sarah Malik (SRE), Raj Patel (Head of Integration), and Emily Stone (Dir, Compliance).
- Procurement: we have a standard procurement window — legal & procurement will need the final commercial terms + an SOW; aiming for signature in the July 1–15 window. Can you include a procurement checkpoint on Week 6 with the specific ask (SOW + PO)?
- Security: yes, we will require SOC2 evidence and a short security questionnaire. I attached our internal risk checklist (Orion_Risk_Checklist.xlsx) that you can use to map to Week 3 activities.

If you can update the doc to call out the owners and add the procurement milestone (SOW/PO), we’ll take a quick internal review and then set up the 30-minute alignment call next week.

Thanks — Lisa
Lisa Crawford
VP, Digital Solutions | Orion Health
lisa.crawford@orionhealth.com

Folks — forwarding Lisa’s note. They want the MAP to include the three named approvers (Sarah, Raj, Emily), add a procurement checkpoint for SOW/PO in Week 6, and include SOC2 evidence mapping in Week 3.

Can we do the following before our alignment call?
- Marcus: can you own the solutions section and add a short checklist for integration steps + test data expectations?
- Monica: can you own onboarding + UAT acceptance criteria and add a simple go/no-go checklist?
- Aditya: can you prepare a one-paragraph note on procurement flow (SOW -> PO -> invoice) and what legal typically needs to see so we can include it in the Week 6 milestone?

I attached some brief internal authoring notes I use for MAPs (MAP_authoring_notes.md). I’ll consolidate your edits into the shared GDoc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xOrionDraftLink

Naomi

Thanks Naomi / Lisa — I updated the draft and pushed a PDF export for quick review (Orion_MAP_Draft_v2.pdf attached) and the editable doc at the same link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xOrionDraftLink

Quick notes on what I changed:
- Added owners: Sarah (SRE) -> integration signoff; Raj -> test data validation; Emily -> compliance checklist owner
- Expanded Week 3 into a two-day SOC2 evidence handoff + 3 days of remediation guidance so their security team has time to review artifacts
- Procurement milestone now specifies SOW template + PO format we prefer; Aditya, please add the short procurement flow blurb Naomi requested
- Added a short success metric section (target latency p95 < 350ms; token-cost budget estimate; evaluation pass-rate > 85% on their prompt set)

Proposed alignment call: Wed 2026-05-12 10:00am PT / 1:00pm ET — 30 minutes. If that works for the Orion team I’ll send a calendar invite and attach the agenda (30m: 10m kickoff + owners review, 10m security/procurement, 10m next steps & acceptance criteria).

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com
